content.class.warden.blurb: 镇公所为山丘下的大厅设有一名守卫，今年轮到你：击倒集结的亡兵，把征召名册放回保存名单的地方。
content.class.warden.kit.0.name: 守卫长剑
content.class.warden.kit.1.name: 守卫盾牌
content.class.warden.kit.2.name: 守卫链甲
content.class.warden.name: 大厅守望者
content.fx.the-muster.done.0.narrate: 集结的亡兵已倒下。阁楼梯、地窖口和库房楼梯都敞开了。地窖梯上方的格栅没有动。
content.fx.the-roll.oc.try-the-ladder.0.narrate: 梯子在格栅下方就到头了。格栅只能从大厅拉开，从这里上不去，只能绕长路走库房楼梯上去。
content.fx.trig.the-hall-at-dusk.0.narrate: 一百年前，哈罗盖特的征召兵在这座大厅集合，从此再没回家。每到黄昏，亡魂仍会降临在大厅地面。镇长把大厅所有出路都闩上，不让他们离开；只有亡灵倒下，门闩才会升起。
content.obj.the-bars.look-down-the-hatch.hint: 地窖口在大厅地板上，靠近阁楼梯脚。
content.obj.the-bars.look-down-the-hatch.title: 查看地窖口
content.obj.the-bars.try-the-grating.hint: 大厅地面上有一块格栅，在磨石旁边，离地窖口几步远，底下有梯子。
content.obj.the-bars.try-the-grating.title: 查看格栅
content.obj.the-bars.try-the-loft-stair.hint: 石梯在大厅后墙，通向阁楼。
content.obj.the-bars.try-the-loft-stair.title: 查看阁楼梯
content.obj.the-bars.try-the-stores-stair.hint: 穿过敞开的门进入库房。通往地窖的楼梯在库房地板上。
content.obj.the-bars.try-the-stores-stair.title: 查看库房楼梯
content.obj.the-muster.put-down-the-muster.hint: 亡兵站在大厅地板上，就在库房门后面。
content.obj.the-muster.put-down-the-muster.title: 击倒集结的亡兵
content.obj.the-roll.draw-the-grating.hint: 走库房楼梯上去，穿过库房门回到大厅，拉开梯子上方的格栅。
content.obj.the-roll.draw-the-grating.title: 从大厅拉开格栅
content.obj.the-roll.lay-the-roll.hint: 爬大厅后墙的阁楼梯。顶端的闩已经打开了。
content.obj.the-roll.lay-the-roll.title: 把名册放进阁楼
content.obj.the-roll.take-the-roll.hint: 从打开的活板门跳进地窖。名册在角落的箱子里。
content.obj.the-roll.take-the-roll.title: 取走征召名册
content.obj.the-roll.try-the-ladder.hint: 地窖里木柱旁的梯子通到大厅地面。
content.obj.the-roll.try-the-ladder.title: 爬地窖梯子
content.quest.the-bars.goal: 抵达哈罗盖特下方的集合大厅，尝试所有出路：阁楼梯、地窖口、地窖梯上方的格栅和库房楼梯，每条出路都被闩住，直到亡灵倒下门闩才会打开。
content.quest.the-muster.goal: 当死去的征召兵降临到大厅地面时将其击倒，让阁楼梯、地窖口和库房楼梯的门闩打开。
content.quest.the-roll.goal: 跳进地窖拿走征召名册，绕长路经库房返回，从大厅拉开地窖梯上方的格栅，再把名册放到阁楼。
content.world.outro: 名册在阁楼摊开着，下方大厅地板上再无亡灵降临。
content.world.title: 集结阁

source.class.warden.blurb: The reeve's office keeps a warden for the hall under the hill. This year it is you: put the muster down, and see the levy's roll laid where the names are kept.
source.class.warden.kit.0.name: Warden's sword
source.class.warden.kit.1.name: Warden's shield
source.class.warden.kit.2.name: Warden's mail
source.class.warden.name: Hall Warden
source.fx.the-muster.done.0.narrate: The muster has fallen. The loft stair, the cellar hatch and the stores stair stand open. The grating over the cellar ladder has not moved.
source.fx.the-roll.oc.try-the-ladder.0.narrate: The ladder ends under the grating. It is drawn from the hall, and there is no way to it from here but the long way round, up the stores stair.
source.fx.trig.the-hall-at-dusk.0.narrate: The Harrowgate levy mustered in this hall a hundred years ago and never came home. At dusk the dead still fall in on its floor. The reeve barred every way out of the hall so they could not leave, and the bars lift only when the muster falls.
source.obj.the-bars.look-down-the-hatch.hint: The hatch is in the hall floor, near the foot of the loft stair.
source.obj.the-bars.look-down-the-hatch.title: Look down the cellar hatch
source.obj.the-bars.try-the-grating.hint: A grating lies in the hall floor beside a grindstone, a few steps from the hatch, with a ladder under it.
source.obj.the-bars.try-the-grating.title: Look at the grating
source.obj.the-bars.try-the-loft-stair.hint: The stone stair climbs the wall at the back of the hall, toward the loft.
source.obj.the-bars.try-the-loft-stair.title: Try the loft stair
source.obj.the-bars.try-the-stores-stair.hint: Go through the open door into the stores. The stair down to the cellar is in its floor.
source.obj.the-bars.try-the-stores-stair.title: Try the stores stair
source.obj.the-muster.put-down-the-muster.hint: The levy stands on the hall floor, back through the stores door.
source.obj.the-muster.put-down-the-muster.title: Put down the muster
source.obj.the-roll.draw-the-grating.hint: Go up the stores stair, back through the stores door into the hall, and draw the grating over the ladder.
source.obj.the-roll.draw-the-grating.title: Draw the grating from the hall
source.obj.the-roll.lay-the-roll.hint: Climb the loft stair at the back of the hall. The bars at its head are gone.
source.obj.the-roll.lay-the-roll.title: Lay the roll in the loft
source.obj.the-roll.take-the-roll.hint: Drop through the open hatch into the cellar. The roll is in the chest in its corner.
source.obj.the-roll.take-the-roll.title: Take the levy's roll
source.obj.the-roll.try-the-ladder.hint: The ladder beside the timber post in the cellar goes up to the hall floor.
source.obj.the-roll.try-the-ladder.title: Climb the cellar ladder
source.quest.the-bars.goal: Arrive in the muster hall under Harrowgate and try every way out of it: the loft stair, the cellar hatch, the grating over the cellar ladder and the stores stair, each barred until the muster falls.
source.quest.the-muster.goal: Put down the dead levy when it falls in on the hall floor, so the bars on the loft stair, the cellar hatch and the stores stair come up.
source.quest.the-roll.goal: Drop into the cellar and take the levy's roll, come back the long way round by the stores, draw the grating over the cellar ladder from the hall, and lay the roll in the loft.
source.world.outro: The roll lies open in the loft, and nobody falls in on the hall floor below.
source.world.title: The Muster Loft
